name: @mila/mcp
description: Mila MCP Server for AI Coding Agents — connect Mila to Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf, Antigravity

scripts.build: bun run build:bundle && bun run build:types
scripts.build:bundle: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --splitting --external @mila/registry --external @mila/rules --external @mila/review && mkdir -p dist/bin && printf '#!/usr/bin/env node\nimport "../index.js";\n' > dist/bin/mila-mcp.js && chmod +x dist/bin/mila-mcp.js
